title: 高盛Michelle Cheng：价格战为何"不活跃"？
speaker: Michelle Cheng

segments.en: Because we know inflation isn't as quick in the last few years compared to the previous decade, right? So that might be, is that why we're getting not as robust growth rates or pick up here because the prices are just steady?
segments.zh: 因为我们知道，过去几年通胀不像前十年那么快，对吧？所以这可能就是为什么增长没那么强劲，因为价格只是平稳？

segments.en: True. On the one side, if we compare early of the year, honestly, pricing trend hasn't been excited, especially you do have this inflation risk kicking in.
segments.zh: 确实。一方面，如果和年初相比，老实说价格趋势并不令人兴奋，尤其是还有通胀风险在显现。

segments.en: So if we recall in first half around Chinese New Year, we mentioned that holiday sales was much better even on high base, but after Chinese New Year things are slowing down.
segments.zh: 回想上半年春节前后，我们提到假期销售在高基数下仍好得多，但春节后情况在放缓。

segments.en: So from the pricing perspective, like June 18, promotion activity is still very intense and we are about to enter another very important holiday season, single-stay. I think people are still very worried about the promotion activity.
segments.zh: 所以从价格角度看，618促销活动仍然非常激烈，我们即将进入另一个重要假期季。我认为人们仍然非常担心促销活动。

segments.en: So on the one side, it's slow, but company, to some say they still want to get a big share or drive the sales skills. So pricing is not active.
segments.zh: 所以一方面增长缓慢，但一些公司仍想抢占份额或推动销售。所以价格并不活跃。

segments.en: So even looking ahead, what we learned from the earlier results season is people start to worry, but companies start to worry about inflation risk more.
segments.zh: 所以即使展望未来，我们从早前财报季学到的是，人们开始担忧，但公司更担心通胀风险。

segments.en: Rather than just or about El Nino, it's getting more and more, like, topical. So inflation risk is there, but I think pricing strategy wise, most of the company is still very disciplined and raised the price, but they still work on a lot of things on how to optimize the cost structures to maintain the profitability.
segments.zh: 而不只是厄尔尼诺现象，它越来越成为话题。所以通胀风险存在，但从定价策略看，大多数公司仍很自律并提价，同时仍在优化成本结构以维持盈利能力。

segments.en: So what's to not do is something of a surprise. Anything turn out better than you thought?
segments.zh: 所以没做什么反而有点意外。有什么比你预想的更好吗？

segments.en: Yeah. We have some negative. So positive surprise, one is all-bound travel.
segments.zh: 是的。我们也有一些负面。正面惊喜之一是出境游。

segments.en: So domestic traffic is only 0 to 1%, but all-bound traffic is 6 to 7%. And in Hong Kong, you feel a lot of people here, and Hong Kong is 9% to 11%.
segments.zh: 国内客流仅0到1%，但出境客流为6%到7%。在香港能感受到很多人，香港是9%到11%。

segments.en: So all-bound, especially the show hall, has been very popular. And some experience is spending, but it's also very diverged.
segments.zh: 所以出境游，尤其是演出场馆，非常受欢迎。一些体验式消费也在增长，但分化很大。
